isolation: Angola Contruy is the Angola country dataset. It is not Angolar / Ngola of São Tomé. Do not copy data/saotome_dataset/angolar/ into this folder. Do not insert Forro, Lung’Ie, Cabo Verdean, Guinea-Bissau Kriol, Kimbundu, Umbundu, or Angolan Portuguese unless a cited source labels that form as Angola Contruy.
principle: Zero hallucination. Missing data is preferable to incorrect data.

missing_term.message: Translation not available in the verified Angola Contruy database.

license.source_extracts: Cited academic sources retain their original terms. See data/angola_dataset/sources.md.

extraction_notes: Isolated Angola country lexicon. Empty until a source names Angola Contruy. APiCS 36 (Angolar) stays in data/saotome_dataset/angolar/.
